purpose: Distinguish market feature shift from policy/order-state shift, test train-only data processing and direct timing signal learning. No test-row filtering or outcome clipping.
source_population: Original v2 eligible neutral-reference delayed action probes, one row per sampled generation, original statuses/exclusions preserved. Earlier dates only in each fold. All5 consumed test dates retained.
audit: Per-feature missingness, range and central99% exceedance, quantiles, median/IQR shift, descriptive KS distance; no iid p-values.

Train-window-hash reference/calibration split. Up to512 reference rows,1024 calibration rows, fixed seed. Train-fitted robust transforms and nearest distance95% calibration threshold. Separate market and state groups. No test-data adaptation or policy gate.
Frozen-model errors and selected value within seen>=5/sparse1..4/unseen state bins, and within/outside market/state distance support.

Full original VALUE runtime generation population: coarse unseen/sparse flags versus outside individual training ranges. First-generation sampling mismatch. No biased runtime inference sample substituted for all entries.

arms.FROZEN_V2: Saved original POST and WAIT-difference predictions; reference only.
arms.RAW_DIRECT: Reuse frozen POST prediction; fit raw POST-minus-WAIT target directly on original71 inputs, pinned LightGBM params/rounds.
arms.COMPACT_DIRECT: Fit raw POST and direct timing delta with pinned LightGBM on36 predeclared economic inputs plus train-fitted missing/extreme flags.
arms.COMPACT_RIDGE: Same processed inputs and raw economic targets, fixed Ridge alpha100. No tuning.

compact_features: Side-aligned Binance100/250/1000/3000ms returns divided by pre-existing trailing sigma and sqrt(h); signed log flow; PF price changes/microprice/gap divided by known spread; imbalance, own/other public book logs, shown/better queue in30-share units, activity/freshness, candidate price/rung/spread, known inventory/exposure/capacity in lots, remaining horizon, waiting age/change, sigma and basis.
preprocessing: Fit bounds0.5/99.5%, median and IQR only on each training fold; impute missing values, retain missing/low/high flags where variable in training, remove constant/duplicate training columns. Never fit transforms on later test rows. No economic label clipping, class balancing by realized outcome or row deletion.
interpretation: Removing overlapping ultra-short windows is a declared ablation, not proof those windows are noise. Processing may hide useful extreme magnitudes; raw model retained and all outcomes evaluated. Existing neutral-KEEP target limitations remain.
evaluation: Report every arm on every side/date and full sample. RMSE/R2/rank IC versus prior means and earlier-data rung/price baseline. Selection POST>0 AND delta>=0. 500-draw null matched on day/side/hour/rung and action count, original metric actual delta and positive actual POST. Insufficient action variation fails. No full-portfolio acceptance or significance claim for covariate-shift statistics.
verification: Nine synthetic tests: units/signs, no future/outcome dependence, train-frozen preprocessing with extreme/missing flags, constant/duplicate/schema/infinite refusals, chronology, shift positive controls, distance support/refusal, regularized direction learning, absolute+incremental entry gate.
execution: Own core8 via run_light; parent size queue yields, current worker finishes normally, identity-checked finally and ExecStopPost resume. MemoryMax2G, one thread. Frozen files checked between stages; failed output namespace preserved. No repeated run on failure without a superseding receipt.
